title: Ai-trading winners are not real, prove me wrong
author: Tradestar_Insider
selftext:
I do not want to know your secrets, you can keep those for yourselves, all I want to know is if you are real people. I don't believe that any guy can just pay $100 a month to Claude and create a successful trading bot. I tried it for half a year with everything set up but no matter what, I always got the same answer from my bot "no edge found" - he could not find a successful trading strategy, that is why I believe this AI-trading hype is just a scam for people to subscribe to Claude or Grok or whatever money-grabbing company there is. I believe it's the same braindead slop as "learn clipping before GTA6 comes out and make money clipping famous streamers' streams".

That is why I want proof from a guy that "made it" and show me proof of his earnings and his brand new BMW for example because I think you are all paid actors by those greedy multimillion-dollar companies.

comments.author: Loose_Bookkeeper_433
comments.body: AI is a tool, it will not find the edge itself. You need to find a strategy that works and then guide the agent.

comments.author: curioussharma-007
comments.body:
You are wrong. I pay $200 for claude Max and $18/mo for hostinger VPS + $5/month for my demat API, started 11 months back and making money in Indian stock market. Yes, edge is difficult however it depends on how much have you tested. I tested over 900+ strategies shared on YT, IG, books and reddit to come up with 9 strategies that has made oney in 11.5 years of backtest data and out of which, after forward test 2 of them are making me money sine last 45 days. 

Issue is people don't backtest properly with fills and then doesn't paper test for atleast 2 months. There's a cycle to Algobots, you cannot skip a part.

comments.author: DadsGamesandCharles
comments.body:
It’s all in how you prompt it. And that starts with you. 

If you prompt the AI and say find me an edge or make me money, then you are going to get the most generic results possible and you’ll have no edge. You have to provide the logic for everything. If you can’t figure out how to get what you want somehow then the AI will never find you an edge.

You have to know what kind of edge you’re looking for before you have an edge using an agent. I get that that sounds a little weird because you’re using the agent to find your edge, but really you need to think of the agent as a confirmation source.

comments.author: Mr_Hodlerr
comments.body:
Not a paid actor. You're also half right: "no edge found" is the honest answer most of the time. Most ideas fail once you test them on enough data with costs included. A bot built over a weekend usually proves it.

I build an AI trading product, so here are our public numbers.

We run [Claude live against our AI](https://botsfolio.com/battle/botsfolio-ai-vs-claude) on the same cryptos with $50k of paper money each. Oct 9 to the Nov 16 close:

Holding BTC and ETH: -24.19%

Claude Opus 5.5: -7.87% (traded $257k, paid $180 in fees)

Our AI: -5.51% (traded $91k, paid $64 in fees)

So Claude isn't useless. It just trades far more than it needs to.

Real money is what counts. Ours has traded real money since Oct 22: down 5.16% while holding the same cryptos fell 27.11%. Still a loss, so no BMW. Every trade is in a public log: [https://botsfolio.com/track-record/real-money](https://botsfolio.com/track-record/real-money) and we log evrything and anchor it with Bitcoin so you know trade history is not tampered: [https://botsfolio.com/track-record/verify](https://botsfolio.com/track-record/verify)

What has worked for us isn't a magic entry. It's losing a lot less when the market falls.
